importantFindings: DeFever 38 Wood Passagemaker legacy production start was unreliable: a documented 1972 example exists, so its start year is left unresolved rather than preserving 1979.
Nordic Tug 26 has three useful production phases: original, 2-26 update, and post-2009 reintroduction.
Nordic Tug 32 has 2002 32+ and 2008 prop-pocket production changes; these remain phases of the same 32 record.
Nordic Tug 39 replaced the 37 on the same Lynn Senour hull; distinct model names are retained with explicit lineage.
Kadey-Krogen 42 uses construction phases for the 1985 fiberglass-superstructure change and 1995 solid-fiberglass-hull change.
The existing Kadey-Krogen 44 AE record incorrectly spanned the earlier 44. It has been split into KDKR-44 (44 Trawler, 2004–2012) and KDKR-44-AE (Advanced Ergonomics, 2012–current).
Kadey-Krogen 48 North Sea production range corrected to 1996–2010.
Willard evidence confirms Vega was a hull-style designation, while Voyager/Nomad/etc. were actual model identities; the later post-1977 Willard 40 is not merged with the Vega 40 Nomad.
